cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern. Hold it level; I taught you that grip on your first parade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you finally kept it upright without me. A successful probation. Put on this badge; you're our Keeper now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you've trained a successor to hold it properly. I didn't hand it to you until you were ready; give the next Keeper the same care.
